obligations.target: Proves that typography remains legible with proper proportions and form controls remain contained within their boundaries on desktop viewports without overflowing.
obligations.reason: Layout containment, control boundary overflow, and typography rendering proportions require real browser rendering and viewport dimensions.

obligations.target: Proves that typography scales without clipping and form controls fit within narrow mobile viewports without unintended horizontal scrolling.
obligations.reason: Validating viewport-relative responsive text scaling, lack of clipping, and absence of horizontal page scrolling can only be observed in a real browser at mobile viewport dimensions.

obligations.target: Proves that when webcam capabilities are unsupported, a clear notification message is displayed and manual ID entry input and submit controls remain visible and interactive.
obligations.reason: Detection of unsupported camera capability and conditional rendering of the notification message and interactive manual fallback inputs can be verified at the unit altitude in Vitest.

obligations.target: Proves that when webcam scanning is supported, the QR webcam scanner interface is initialized and accessible alongside manual ID entry controls.
obligations.reason: Camera capability detection and concurrent presentation of the webcam scanner interface and manual entry controls are fully provable via unit tests in Vitest.

obligations.target: Proves that entering a registration identifier into the manual ID entry field processes the submission and displays the registration outcome confirmation.
obligations.reason: Processing the manual identifier form submission and rendering the resulting registration outcome or confirmation is a behavioral contract verified at unit altitude in Vitest.
